name: PSS-10 (stress screening test)
questions: How often have you felt things were out of your control?
How often have you felt nervous or stressed?
How often have you struggled to cope with daily tasks?
How often have you felt confident in handling personal problems?
How often have you felt things were going your way?
How often have you been upset because of unexpected events?
How often have you felt overwhelmed?
How often have you felt anger due to events outside your control?
How often have you found yourself unable to keep up with demands?
How often have you felt that difficulties were piling up?
